prompts: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a CVPR/NeurIPS camera-ready architecture diagram. Wide landscape, pure #ffffff white background. Flat VECTOR-STYLE illustration, uniform thin charcoal connectors with arrowheads, clean sans-serif English only, generous whitespace. Absolutely no photos, no gradients, shadows, 3D, textures, saturated colors, paragraphs or long sentences. Pastel blue spatial modules, pastel sage token modules, pale peach masks, pale lavender supervision. Compact labels only. All shapes aligned on a precise grid. Small flat token bars and 2D grid icons allowed. Correct graph more important than ornament. Title "E Cross-Attention". Three horizontal lanes. Top token lane: "CT" -> "ViT" -> "z" -> "Collector" -> "TGEnc" -> "20 tokens" -> "Mean Pool + Proj" -> "q". Bottom spatial lane: CT->"Shallow CNN"; z and Shallow CNN->"Pixel Decoder"->"P4". q and P4->"Cross-Attn + FFN"->"q'". q' and ORIGINAL P4->"Cosine Readout"->"Upsample"->"Mask". Route inputs with short orthogonal wires, no crossing text. Small third reconstruction lane from original20tokens->"AHER"->"Canvas Fusion"->"Recon Decoder"->"Recon Loss". Add tiny badges "MAE init" beneath ViT and "112 x 112" under P4. Diagram must show only one query reading P4, not multiscale token refinement. No freezing icons. No imaginary dimensions. Fusion/recon decoder shared, Collector/TGEnc/AHER per organ. Avoid long explanatory footer.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create a CVPR/NeurIPS camera-ready architecture diagram. Wide landscape, pure #ffffff white background. Flat VECTOR-STYLE illustration, uniform thin charcoal connectors with arrowheads, clean sans-serif English only, generous whitespace. Absolutely no photos, no gradients, shadows, 3D, textures, saturated colors, paragraphs or long sentences. Pastel blue spatial modules, pastel sage token modules, pale peach masks, pale lavender supervision. Compact labels only. All shapes aligned on a precise grid. Small flat token bars and 2D grid icons allowed. Correct graph more important than ornament. Title "SAM-tail: Soft Prior + Aux". Top small backbone strip "CT" -> "ViT + CNN" -> "Pixel Decoder" -> "P16 / P8 / P4". Main token lane "Collector + TGEnc" -> "20 tokens" -> "Projection" -> "Read P16" -> "Read P8" -> "Read P4" -> "SAM-tail" -> "Dynamic Readout" -> "Mask". Token source is ViT z, not pixel decoder. Draw exactly three sequential read blocks. Above EACH read use a small peach "Prior" node computed from incoming tokens BEFORE that read and matching pixel map, not read output. Prior branches into lavender "Aux" AND "Stop-grad" -> "Log Gate" feeding corresponding read as attention bias. Display one compact formula near priors "log(0.2 + 0.8p)" and short aux label "Upsample to GT". P4 also directly supplies SAM-tail. Tiny label inside SAM-tail "Mask token | Two-way | Final read"; no coarse prior into tail. Dynamic readout is MLP mask vector dot tail-updated pixels. Bottom miniature branch from original20tokens "AHER" -> "Fusion" -> "Recon Decoder" -> "Recon Loss". Do not add feature dimensions, long prose or metrics. Avoid feedback loops: priors from PRE-read inputs.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create a CVPR/NeurIPS camera-ready architecture diagram. Wide landscape, pure #ffffff white background. Flat VECTOR-STYLE illustration, uniform thin charcoal connectors with arrowheads, clean sans-serif English only, generous whitespace. Absolutely no photos, no gradients, shadows, 3D, textures, saturated colors, paragraphs or long sentences. Pastel blue spatial modules, pastel sage token modules, pale peach masks, pale lavender supervision. Compact labels only. All shapes aligned on a precise grid. Small flat token bars and 2D grid icons allowed. Correct graph more important than ornament. Title "SAM-tail: Coarse-to-Fine". Top backbone lane "CT" -> "ViT + CNN" -> "Pixel Decoder" -> "P16 / P8 / P4". Token lane from ViT z "Collector + TGEnc" -> "20 tokens" -> "Projection" -> "Read P16" -> "Read P8" -> "Read P4" -> "T'". Exactly sequential three reads, matching maps supply each. T' plus originalP4 feed "Coarse Mask". Coarse Mask branches into "Coarse Loss" receiving "GT"->"Nearest Downsample", and "Sigmoid"->"Value Gate" that feeds "SAM-tail". T' AND originalP4 ALSO feed SAM-tail directly. Tail->"Mask MLP" gives vector w; tail also outputs "P4'" ; w and P4'->"Dot Product"->"Upsample"->"Final Mask"->"Final Loss" receiving full GT. Use small pale background grouping for "Coarse" and "Fine" stages. Label gate "no detach", applies token-to-pixel V only. No masks guiding the three multiscale reads. Small bottom reconstruction lane originaltokens->"AHER"->"Fusion"->"Recon Decoder". English SHORT labels, no paragraphs, no long formulas. Do not draw CT pictures or mask photographs.

selected_edits.e: Edit this architecture diagram preserving all nodes, arrows and English labels. Replace BOTH CT photographic tiles with simple pale-gray outlined squares labeled 'CT', with a minimal 2D grid icon only. Remove all gradients and shadows from EVERY module, use uniform flat pastel fills. Entire background pure white. No photographic content anywhere. All other graph connectivity unchanged.
selected_edits.soft: Restyle this diagram ONLY. Preserve every arrow, branch dot, module position, input and output. Pure white, flat extremely pale pastel fills, charcoal thin borders, zero gradients/shadows. Reduce label verbosity: three orange boxes simply 'Coarse Mask'; three gate boxes 'Stop-grad / Log Gate'; note 'Aux: Full GT'; output readout 'MLP + Dot'; remove bottom two long banners and large legend. Keep short title. All three purple attention-bias arrows MUST remain connected gate-to-read; coarse mask inputs branch BEFORE read, exactly as reference. Do not move wires. No photos. Professional minimalist CVPR figure, compact well spaced English short labels.
selected_edits.downsample: Restyle this correct diagram to minimalist CVPR flat vector style. Pure white background, extremely light pastel blue, sage, peach and lavender fills, thin charcoal borders, no gradients/shadows. Preserve ALL graph edges and short labels. Remove the entire bottom three explanatory paragraph boxes and bottom long-sentence banner. Shorten title to 'SAM-tail: Downsampled GT'. Shorten long module labels: 'Coarse mask / cosine readout' to 'Coarse Mask'; 'GT -> nearest-neighbor downsample to112x112' to 'GT: Nearest Downsample'; 'SAM-tail: mask token, two-way attention, final token read' to 'SAM-tail'; 'Tail prior: gate projected V' to 'Value Gate'; 'Upsample448x448' to 'Upsample'; 'Final loss with full GT' to 'Final Loss'; 'Mask-token MLP: vector w' to 'Mask MLP'. Keep top sequential Read P16 -> Read P8 -> Read P4 and preserve coarse/final supervision graph exactly. Compact landscape layout with ample whitespace and crisp English typography. No photographs, icons only simple token bars or grids.
